scoring.rule: Only a ledger entry backed by pipeline artifacts and call audit records is scoreable.

METRIC-005.rule: Pass only when all 12 required domains have one completed, artifact-hashed, secret-scan-passing ledger entry.

execution_policy.provider_rule: Provider execution is prohibited unless --execute is supplied, the separate actual_execution_authorization is true, and the frozen Bailian runtime identity is valid. Formal execution rejects --mock.
execution_policy.failure_rule: Only TimeoutError or ConnectionError receive one retry. A terminal failure stops the entire run and is atomically recorded.
execution_policy.global_attempt_rule: The ledger has one immutable global cap of 24 persisted attempts across all domains and every --resume invocation.

actual_execution_authorization.authorization_rule: Authorization applies only after all preflight and clean-room gates pass; actual ablation, PR Ready, approval, and merge remain unauthorized.

question_source.path: Must be the portable repository-relative path data/processed/questions_125.json; absolute paths are forbidden.
question_source.runtime_binding: The relative manifest path resolves from the current clone root. SAGE_QUESTIONS_PATH must be unset or resolve to that same formal source.
question_source.formal_source_rule: The source is a top-level JSON list of exactly 125 objects with unique id values that exactly cover Q001 through Q125. Its SHA-256 must be b6712a3b53f9776d7f695ea67f810c30b7d97ee59c183009432870d3224cdebb.
question_source.item_binding: Each domains entry must include question_id, question, source_domain, normalized_domain, mapping_basis, approval_source, and canonical_input_hash. Optional domain is a compatibility field and must equal normalized_domain. source_domain and question must exactly match the formal source; normalized_domain, mapping_basis, and approval_source must match the complete approved mapping. Q089 maps to materials, Q088 maps to engineering, and Q109 preserves source replacement characters.
question_source.canonical_input_hash: sha256(UTF-8 canonical JSON of question_id, question, source_domain, normalized_domain with ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':')); no text normalization is permitted.

manifest_contract.domains_rule: Exactly one ordered entry for every required normalized domain.

artifact_policy.ledger: ledger.json (atomic replace; --resume accepts only the same canonical manifest hash and question_source_binding, which includes canonical source path, file SHA-256, and ordered item-binding digest). global_attempt_count is reconciled from all persisted attempts and must never exceed 24.
artifact_policy.pipeline_artifacts: Use the artifact directory emitted by app.workflow.pipeline.run_pipeline_with_state.
artifact_policy.call_audit: Summarize state.llm_calls using app.core.call_audit.summarize_calls; do not serialize secrets. Completed actual attempts must also prove Bailian/Qwen fixed identity, unique request identities, exact token arithmetic, no fallback, and token-only unpriced cost accounting.
artifact_policy.integrity: Each completed entry records a deterministic artifact hash and secret-scan outcome. Failed attempts retain null token/cost values; completed actual attempts record audited tokens and a null (unpriced) cost.

reproduction.safety_note: Execution remains prohibited until all preflight and clean-room gates pass; this protocol update itself performs no Provider call.
